title: MZ Saving over an save with js call

posts.author: LordLaxy
posts.body: Hello There. For my games I use a self made menu thats mostly made of events with a lil more events. Anywho for my save "system" Im using a pretty simple script call to save the game. But this call doesnt support the saving over a save. If there is already a save the call just doesnt do anything. So can someone maybe help me motifi the call so that it CAN save over an already made save in that set save slot?

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
are you certain that the save hasnt been saved? the function allows for overwriting normally if plugins arent involved. the promise returned on a successful save is the number
0,
so you would get your error message if you ran it as 0 is falsy but it still should have saved the file

posts.body:
I would recommend to put this into a plugin, and call a function something
like:
fuction SavingProgress() {/*your code*/}  and call that one.
scriptcalls has a max 11 lines (unless changed in MZ, so opening it later will remove
everything more than 11 lines.
a 1 liner can work too, but making it a function is 1 call and it runs that code.
but its only a feedback

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Looks like it's the
Continue/Load
entry from the MV / MZ Script Call List:
RPG Maker MV / MZ Script Call List
This Script Call list applies to both RPG Maker MV and RPG Maker MZ. Link here to see the entire list.    Supplementary Material for RPG Maker MZ: https://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?threads/rpg-maker-mz-script-call-reference.122501/  Have fun eventing~
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Here's a screenshot for quick reference (click to view full size):
Make sure to read the
Notes
column! See how
loadSuccess
,
loadFailure
, and
afterLoad
have been replaced with actual code in the example?
This particular script call does have a few extra quirks, though. It can bug out in various situations (e.g. loading a save made on a map with fewer events than are on the current map?), since the core scripts are not designed to permit loading a save during a frame update on the map.
You could try out feature
D21
(synchronous save/load plugin commands) of my plugin Cae_Tweaks:
MZ - Cae_Tweaks - lots of little features
Cae_Tweaks v19 updated 2026-06-16 (UTC+0)  Terms of Use MIT License: https://opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.html  Description The plugin file must be named Cae_Tweaks.js.  This plugin contains a bunch of different things. It's mostly just me slowly making a game and coding some more stuff...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
It now has a "Safe Load" parameter: when this is enabled, it performs the actual load on a separate scene, which based on my testing seems to eliminate all problems. All features of Cae_Tweaks are disabled by default, so if you want to try it out then you'll need to scroll down the parameter list and set
D21: Save/Load Commands
to
true
.
